WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS matched_order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  matched_order_count,
  matched_order_count::numeric / SUM(matched_order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
  matched_order_count::numeric / AVG(matched_order_count) OVER () AS count_over_average
FROM scope_counts;
